name: Paragraphs tabs bootstrap
description: Renders a Paragraphs reference field as Bootstrap 5 horizontal or vertical tabs, with a matching widget and an AJAX add-component form.
project_description:
This module is designed to organize of diverse paragraph types within your Drupal content by grouping them into horizontal or vertical tabs, using the Bootstrap 5 format. Whether you want to enhance the visual presentation of your content or improve user experience, this module provides a simple solution.

 Usage Guide: 
 
 Use with bootstrap 5 theme . 
 Create Paragraphs Field: Begin by creating a field for paragraphs in your content type. 
 Configure Field Settings: In the field settings, choose the option for "Multi-Paragraphs Type." 
 Select Formatter/Widget: Under the formatter / widget, choose "Paragraphs Tabs". Further customize the display by selecting either vertical or horizontal tab mode. 
 
 By following these steps, you can effortlessly organize and present various paragraph types within Bootstrap 5 tabs, enhancing the visual appeal and navigability of your Drupal content.
